title: Daily discovery
description: Four fixed technical channels sync after 08:00 Beijing time each day. Editions appear once complete; refresh reads published content.

sourceFilter.label: Source platform
sourceFilter.count: Showing {{count}} of {{total}} items in this edition
sourceFilter.emptyDescription: Try another platform or view all items in this channel.

loadFailed: Unable to load discovery. Please refresh later.

disabled.title: Daily discovery is disabled
disabled.description: It appears in navigation after an administrator enables it and the first edition is published.

initializing.title: Preparing the first edition
initializing.description: The daily sync gathers and organizes content in batches. The edition will appear when complete.

updating.title: A new edition is in progress
updating.description: The most recently published complete edition remains available.

empty.title: No content in this channel yet
empty.description: This sync found no content matching the channel rules. The next daily sync will check again.

partial.title: Some sources have not updated
partial.description: Showing successful updates alongside previous source content that is still within its retention window.

failed.title: The latest sync did not finish
failed.description: There is no available edition yet. A later sync will retry.
failed.withItems: Showing the last successful edition. Source timestamps are listed below.

saveFailed: Unable to save. Please try again.
rankingNote: Recommendations combine source-specific rankings. GitHub shows actual Stars and sample growth, HN shows points and comments, and RSS shows recent updates. Metrics are never added across sources.
